implementation.pricePrecision: Decimal strings kept as decimal strings; no IEEE-754 conversion for output amounts.

credentialFreeControl.request: One read-only POST with method=aliexpress.affiliate.product.query and format=json; no app_key, sign, cookies, authorization header, or user session.
credentialFreeControl.interpretation: HTTP 200 was only a platform-level error envelope. No product data was returned and this is not a catalog live pass.

documentedFieldAvailability.productVideo: available when a valid source URL is returned
documentedFieldAvailability.sellerAndCategory: available: shop ID/URL, platform product type, and category IDs/names
documentedFieldAvailability.priceVariants: available: sale/list/app and target-currency values remain separate
documentedFieldAvailability.positiveReviewRate: available through evaluate_rate as a percent string; not average stars or a review count
documentedFieldAvailability.socialRating: available through comment_score with scale unknown and through semantic recent-comment metadata
documentedFieldAvailability.descriptionFeaturesOptionsSkuStock: unavailable on Affiliate query/detail and Social item search
documentedFieldAvailability.reviewBodiesAndReviewPhotos: unavailable; product image galleries are not customer review photos

liveBlockers: Affiliate methods require a registered AliExpress/TOP app_key and matching app_secret, even though their official references mark user Session authorization as not required. No usable app credentials were available in the authorized task input.
Dropship aliexpress.ds.product.get requires a user-authorized dropshipper Session.
Dropship aliexpress.offer.ds.product.simplequery requires authorization and is documented for selected buyers only.
